description: 20 mm cube with three through-holes of diameter 1.0, 1.5, 2.5 mm. Edge-based hole-depth detection should report each hole's depth as ~20 mm. The 1.0 mm hole is below FDM/SLA/SLS minimum hole diameters and below the small-feature threshold, so multiple categories fire on additive processes. CNC_MILL warns on cavity_depth (long stickout for 1 mm tools).
